thread:
maya: Heads-up — our IdP cert rotation triggered the rotation pipeline and the preflight failed but pipeline continued. SCIM started returning 403s ~5m after the run. Seeing KMS decrypt denies for the provisioner. Logs snippet:
```
2026-05-05T03:10:11Z scim-provisioner error="AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt denied" principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/scim-provisioner
2026-05-05T03:10:12Z scim-provisioner http 403 PATCH /Users/42 -> {"error":"forbidden"}
```
Can someone take triage? @ops-lead @lia-security

trent: I'm oncall. Quick check — did preflight run any key policy diffs or re-encrypt jobs? If preflight failed it should have aborted. maya, paste the pipeline stage logs.

maya: pipeline id infra-rotate-20260505-03. Preflight shows failed healthcheck for scim but operator flag `continue_on_preflight=true` was set. I didn't realize. infra-automation user executed PutKeyPolicy at 03:08:57Z.

infra-automation: [AUDIT] event=PutKeyPolicy user=infra-automation key=alias/scim-provisioner time=2026-05-05T03:08:57Z change=add_notprincipal_whitelist id=pkp-9922

lia-security: that NotPrincipal pattern can be dangerous. If the whitelist omitted runtime roles, kms:Decrypt will be blocked. Check CloudTrail for PutKeyPolicy and UpdateAssumeRolePolicy in the 03:07-03:12 window. Also check whether any ReEncrypt or GenerateDataKey events occurred.

trent: pulling key policy now. Found a NotPrincipal that excludes many internal roles including scim-provisioner. Also saw an inline role policy change that tightened conditions on `kms:Decrypt`. Both happened in the same window. Root cause likely automation applied an overly broad deny.

ops-lead: mitigation plan: 1) revert key policy to add scim-provisioner back, 2) set SCIM deprovision grace to 96h and pause prune, 3) disable `continue_on_preflight` and fix pipeline to fail hard. Who can apply #1 now? @maya or @trent?

maya: applying rollback now. Command used: 
```bash
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/scim-provisioner --policy file://allow-scim-provisioner.json
kubectl set env deployment/scim-provisioner -n infra SCIM_DEPROV_GRACE_HOURS=96
```

trent: after rollback I'm seeing KMS decrypt succeed and PATCH 200s. sample: 
```
2026-05-05T03:18:05Z scim-provisioner http 200 PATCH /Users/42 user=ellen@example.com action=update
```
ops-lead: good. Keep monitoring for role flapping; run a reconciliation for users touched during 03:09-03:20 window.

lia-security: follow-ups: - require PR review for any infra automation that mutates KMS policies - add a diff alerter for PutKeyPolicy that notifies security + oncall if principals are removed - change pipeline default to abort on failed preflight - add a CI test that validates runtime principals persist after rotation. I'll own the alerting work.

maya: note: because we restored the policy we didn't need to re-encrypt tokens. If a rekey had completed we'd need to re-encrypt and rotate secrets in Vault; add that checklist to runbook.

ops-lead: assign owners: @trent write postmortem draft, @lia-security own gating/alerting, @maya update runbook + attach logs. ETA EOD.
